open_questions: 1. Owner ruling on the -99/-999 words (OW-13, D-G13). research/globe/README.md section 2 gives D-G13 the default 'No radar data' for new layers; the review's conditional fix ('No radar value ... meaning not verified') was applied because p0-gates.json records the meaning as 'not settled'. Reverting is one string in storm.py _describe() plus the test expectations.

2. Quiet weather: at 4:12 am MDT on 2026-10-17 all 14 towns read 'No radar value'. The independent 0.5 km check (10:02:38 UTC) shows 99.97% of Montana cells at -999 and no valid dBZ. The feed cannot say whether -999 means clear air or no coverage. Carson should see this before the text reaches anyone (AGENTS rule 5).

3. Ground height: the live text uses the NWS grid point elevation (Billings 975.1 m); research/globe/validation-evidence/terrain.json gives USGS 3DEP terrain of 951.9 to 953.4 m for Billings. Owner's call before P2.

4. storm.js is a new JavaScript duty that research/globe/README.md section 9b does not list. It needs Carson's ruling (ROADMAP Next 9) and a 9b row with the cap proposed in tests/test_storm.py. research/ is outside this edit scope.
5. Placement: the storm block is last in the List and sits between Observed now and the 24-hour table on town pages. Owner's call.

6. eccodes noise: the flag-on live build writes 22 'Truncating time' lines (2,046 B) when it reads validityDate and validityTime of files whose times have seconds (for example 10:02:38). Values are unaffected (the time check allows 2 minutes); the flag-off build writes none. Decide whether to read the time from the file name instead.

7. website.yml lines 7 and 18 (branch filters) name two AI vendors' products. Pre-existing and not changed here; changing them changes CI triggers. tests/test_website_workflow.py line 58 (HEAD line 58, not added here) uses a branch name with one of those product names as a test fixture; the test needs only a non-main ref, so a neutral name would do. Not changed.

8. The default sample build now shows different sample grid heights on town pages (for example Livingston 4,593 ft, was 3,609 ft). The sample is labelled SAMPLE; the live build is unaffected; the test was updated.
9. Nothing is committed. The change is about 1,000 new or changed lines; the review asked for smaller PRs. Consider splitting the tests and workflow from the page changes.
10. The masked-array fix is latent: the live files returned unmasked arrays (bitmapPresent 0). It is covered by a unit test.
